summaries: A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD press release for August 2022 new residential construction statistics (released September 20, 2022). Contributes the Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rates (SAAR) for total building permits and total housing starts required to calculate the 'unstarted construction balance' for the initial month of the task period (August 2022). Table 1a provides the preliminary SAAR for total building permits at 1,517,000 and Table 3a provides the SAAR for total housing starts at 1,575,000. It also includes revised July 2022 figures in the tables, allowing for historical context, but the primary contribution is the August data which initiates the required 2022/08 to 2025/05 timeline. Values are marked preliminary (p), indicating they may be superseded by more recent reports in the collection.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD monthly statistical release for September 2022 residential construction (released October 19, 2022). Relevant to the task: It provides the Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate (SAAR) figures for total building permits (Table 1a) and housing starts (Table 3a) required to calculate the 'unstarted construction balance' (Permits SAAR minus Starts SAAR). It supplies values for August 2022 (revised) and September 2022 (preliminary), covering the start of the required 2022/08–2025/05 window. Specific SAAR figures include August 2022 (Permits: 1,542; Starts: 1,566) and September 2022 (Permits: 1,564; Starts: 1,439), all in thousands of units. As an earlier report for this period, its values are subject to supersession by later releases under the task's precedence rule. It does not contain data for 2023–2025.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD monthly statistical release on New Residential Construction for October 2022, issued November 17, 2022. Contributes to the task by providing the Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate (SAAR) figures for total building permits (Table 1a) and total housing starts (Table 3a) required to calculate the 'unstarted construction balance' (Permits SAAR minus Starts SAAR). The document covers the United States for August 2022 (revised) through October 2022 (preliminary). Specific figures include August 2022 permits at 1,542, starts at 1,508; September 2022 permits at 1,564, starts at 1,488; and October 2022 permits at 1,526, starts at 1,425 (in thousands). These values enable the calculation of the balance and month-over-month changes for the initial segment of the task's required timeframe (2022/08 to 2025/05). As per the task's precedence rule, later reports in the collection may supersede the August and September figures contained here, though this release is the latest authority for October 2022 data at the time of its publication.
